episode_title: The Audiobook Is Live — and the Opening of HIGH TQ

real_qa.q: What is High TQ and why does it matter more than expertise according to John Patterson?
real_qa.r: High TQ is the capacity to navigate transactions successfully with precision, accuracy, and completeness. According to Patterson, while expertise is being commoditized by AI, how you transact is not. High TQ represents the ability to make exchanges precise, accurate, and complete in whatever register the exchange requires—sometimes warm, sometimes hard, cold, and consequential—enabling professionals to produce the outcomes they actually want rather than repeating unintended results.
real_qa.requete: High TQ definition why matters more than expertise

real_qa.q: When did High TQ book release and what was its initial ranking on Amazon?
real_qa.r: High TQ came out in August 2026 and debuted at number one in the organizational change category on Amazon, holding that position for seven days. Patterson describes this ranking as fitting proof for a book about what actually decides outcomes between people.
real_qa.requete: High TQ book release date August 2026 Amazon ranking

real_qa.q: What is the key question John Patterson asks professionals to reveal the gap in transactional intelligence?
real_qa.r: Patterson asks: "What did you actually agree to?" This question—focusing on what was actually agreed to, not what was intended, assumed, or implied—consistently reveals what he calls the hidden intelligence behind human exchanges. The pause that follows this question is what motivated writing the book, as most professionals struggle to identify the incomplete agreements that drive repeated unwanted outcomes.
real_qa.requete: What did you actually agree to John Patterson question

real_qa.q: How long is the High TQ audiobook narrated by John Patterson?
real_qa.r: The audiobook is seven hours and seventeen minutes long from start to finish. Patterson narrated it himself rather than hiring a professional narrator, deliberately making it sound uniquely human with his own voice, pauses, and imperfect takes, because the book is fundamentally about what happens between people.
real_qa.requete: High TQ audiobook length duration seven hours

real_qa.q: Where can readers access the TQ diagnostic assessment and what does it measure?
real_qa.r: Readers can access a free fifteen-question TQ diagnostic assessment at tqdiagnostic.com, which takes about ten minutes to complete. It reveals your personality in transaction—how you tend to move when something consequential is on the line—and where you land on the high-low TQ spectrum. It is not a test with anything to pass; most people find it uncomfortably accurate.

guest.bio_context: John Patterson is the founder of InfluentialU, a global education company established in 2009 that focuses on Transactional Intelligence (TQ). He has worked with professionals across more than 20 countries including executives, entrepreneurs, salespeople, educators, engineers, and leaders at every level, conducting work in boardrooms in San Francisco, workshops in Toronto, coaching conversations in London, and training rooms from New York to New Zealand. He co-authored the book High TQ with Kirkland Tibbles, which explores the hidden intelligence behind human exchanges and the concept of transactional intelligence.
